cross_market_insights: All four cities show the same pattern: single-villa package listings, directory pages, social posts and a 2024 inspiration list. No ranking page is a planning guide.

No top-3 page compares a private villa with a resort, explains exclusive use, or lists what a villa package leaves out (permits, generator, toilets, curfew, neighbours, wet-weather cover, guest beds, access).
Banjar fees appear only as a line item in a social post; nobody explains what they are or who arranges them.
Capacity is given per package (often 30 guests) but nobody explains how villa capacity, sleeping capacity and event capacity differ.
Holiday-deal and villa-rental pages rank, so intent is mixed; a clear wedding-planning page can win the planning intent.
'bali villa wedding' (210/month) is seven times the primary keyword; the article should carry it naturally in an H2.
payload.reference_only_images: Ranking pages are image-led (villa pools, clifftop lawns, ocean ceremonies). Seen as thumbnails only; reference only, never proposed for use.
